Name: PigHawk
Author: lilierr
Description:
[img]https://ss0.bdstatic.com/70cFuHSh_Q1YnxGkpoWK1HF6hhy/it/u=2140059978,3012253820&fm=26&gp=0.jpg[/img]﻿
Enigmatic pig, who can speak human language, has a clover birthmark on his buttock and a pig hat Pavilion on his left ear. The signboard pig in the pig hat Pavilion is responsible for all kinds of work and handling leftovers in the tavern, claiming to be the head of the "leftovers handling cavalry". It's a pig, but its name is hawk.

Manifest.Name: hawkpig
Manifest.Description: Replaces  PIG with hawk from The Seven Deadly Sins
